_readme: Per-ISO column mapping for residuals import from Dropbox. All column letters are Excel-style (A=col0, B=col1...). verified=true means the column was confirmed against an actual report total. Notes explain special cases.

Authorize.Net.col_paydiversenet_formula_desc: Gateway Fee + CC Transaction Fee + eCheck Fees + Other Fee + Residual Adjustments (L can be negative)
Authorize.Net.notes: Col O (Residual Amount) is total network residual — do NOT use. PayDiverse's cut is the sum of their specific fee columns: E+F+G+K+L. Verified Aug 2026: Jun $943.10 matches report exactly.

Maverick.notes: Col B=MID, Col C=DBA, Col J=Sales Amount (gross vol), Col K=Total Expenses (gross rev), Col L=Total Net Revenue (what Maverick pays PayDiverse → use for iso_payments.expected_amount), Col AC=Agent Net Revenue (PayDiverse's cut after paying Elm Capital sub-agent = paydiversenet). Col AB=Agent Split %, Col AP=Agent Payout to sub-agent. Verified Aug 2026: Jun $4,167 ≈ $4,162.63 from report ($4.50 rounding diff from Eterneva merchant).

Finns.notes: Col B=Merchant, Col D=Amount Processed, Col H=Total Commissions, Col I=Rev Split %, Col J=Net Agent (ELM) = paydiversenet, Col K=Finns (what Finns keeps). File has two rows per merchant (Draft + CC method); only rows with non-zero Col J count. Rev split is ~65%. Verified Aug 2026: Jun $9,078.92 matches report $9,078.91 (1 cent rounding).

CC Bill.notes: WEEKLY billing format — file covers ~12 weeks spanning multiple months. Col E = billing week end date (Excel serial). MUST filter to only weeks where the date falls in the report month (June = Jun 1-30). Col J=weekly volume, Col K=rate (2%), Col L=gross rev (J×K), Col Q=net (L minus ~$5 weekly fee) = paydiversenet per week. Verified Aug 2026: Jun 4 weeks (Jun 7, 14, 21, 28) sum = $1,229.92 exactly.

The HiRisk Processor.notes: Vertical list format: Row 1=company header (Elm Payments), Row 2=period date, Row 3=blank, Row 4='Commission Due' header, Rows 5+=merchant name in Col A and commission in Col B. Row with 'Total' in Col A has the grand total — skip it. gross_revenue and paydiversenet are same column (B = commission due = PayDiverse earnings). Verified Aug 2026: Jun 4 merchants sum = $1,546.46 matches report exactly.

First Direct Financial.notes: Data starts at row 5 (4 blank header rows). Col A=MID, Col B=Merchant Name, Col C=Agent (Greenlight Payments), Col G=Volume, Col H=Gross Revenue, Col M (index 12) = PayDiverse net = paydiversenet. Verified Aug 2026: Jun 10 merchants sum = $1,167.88 matches report exactly.

PayArc.notes: Headers in row 1. Col B=Merchant, Col C=MID, Col H=Captured sales (text with $ — strip $,), Col I=Revenue (text), Col J=Expense, Col K=Gross profit, Col L=Split, Col M='Agent income' = paydiversenet. Dollar-sign columns need text parsing. Verified Aug 2026: Jun 10 merchants sum = $2,106.94 matches report exactly.

Payment Cloud NXGEN.notes: 2-row data format: Row 2 = merchant detail (MID, DBA, Vol, Residual), Row 3 = summary line with only Col O='Partner Comm' = paydiversenet. Use Row 3 Col O as the total paydiversenet (do NOT use Row 2 Col O which is a different/gross value). Col N=Partner % split. Verified Aug 2026: Jun Col O row 3 = $2,161.54 matches report exactly.

MerchantE Fresno.notes: WARNING: In Dropbox, this data is stored in a file labeled 'Merchant E Synovous' — the file naming is WRONG, the data is Fresno. Always import 'Merchant E Synovous' file under Fresno ISO ID. Col B=Org Id, Col C=Disc/IC Income (gross rev), Col D=Disc/IC Expense, Col E=Fees Income, Col F=Fees Expense, Col G=Adjustments, Col L='Net P/L' = paydiversenet. Verified Aug 2026: Jun $505.90 matches report exactly.

MerchantE Synovous.notes: FILE MISLABELED in Dropbox — 'Merchant E Synovous' file actually contains MerchantE FRESNO data. Import this file under the MerchantE Fresno ISO ID (iso_override). Same column structure as Fresno: Col L = Net P/L = paydiversenet.

Revitpay.notes: File has 3 title rows before actual data headers. Header row = Row 4 ('Merchant ID', 'Merchant', 'Processor', 'Hierarchy', 'Description', 'Transactions', 'Sales Amount', 'Income'...). Data starts at Row 5. Col A=Merchant ID (MID), Col B=Merchant name, Col G=Sales Amount, Col H=Income (gross rev), Col M (index 12, 0-based) = paydiversenet. Same format as Taluspay. Verified Aug 2026: Jun 2 merchants = $216.16 matches report exactly.

Taluspay.notes: Same format as Revitpay — has title rows before header. Find header by looking for row containing 'MID' or 'Merchant'. Col M (index 12, 0-based) = paydiversenet. Verified Aug 2026: Jun 2 merchants = $157.75 matches report exactly.

SignaPay.notes: TWO files required per month: (1) Main 'Signapay*.xlsx' with Col A=MID, Col B=DBA, Col I=Volume, Col J=Income, Col M='Net' = paydiversenet per merchant. (2) Adjustment file 'Gross ISO Manual Adjustments*.xlsx' with Col G=Amount = PCI Income adjustments (also paydiversenet). BOTH files live in a 'Signapay' subfolder within the month's Breier folder. Sum both to get total. Verified Aug 2026: Jun main $59.80 + adjustments $35.17 = $94.97 matches report exactly.

MidMetrics.notes: WEEKLY multi-section format. Row 1 = split rate (e.g. 0.35 in Col E). Rows 2-N = weekly data grouped in sections (each section = one merchant). Last data row before end contains the MONTHLY TOTAL in Col E — use that as the single paydiversenet value. Do NOT sum individual rows (they represent weekly sub-periods). Col E = net amount per period. Verified Aug 2026: Jun total row = $1,443.85 matches report exactly.

Nexio.notes: Binary XLS (BIFF8/OLE2) format — requires OLE2 compound document reader and BIFF8 parser. SST (shared string table) contains column headers in order: [Rep Code, Agent, Split Type, Main Rep Code, Main Agent, MID, Merchant Name, Auth Count, Volume, Income, Expense, Gross Residual, Split%, Agent Residual]. Data rows at BIFF8 rows 1-6 (0-indexed). Col N (BIFF8 index 13) = 'Agent Residual' = paydiversenet. MULRK records use offset 6+k*6 (empirically correct for this file). Verified Aug 2026: Jun 6 merchants = $4,827.88 (user report shows $5,580.57 — $752.69 gap suggests some merchants missing from Dropbox copy of file).

Nuvei.notes: Binary XLS (BIFF8/OLE2) format — requires OLE2 parser. No SST strings found (headers may be in merged cells or different encoding). Col 88 (0-indexed) = Agent Net Residual = paydiversenet. This is computed as: agent processing residuals (col 65) + adjustments (col 84). Merchant rows identified by col 5 (gross volume) > 10,000. Adjustment rows (col 5 between 0 and 10,000) also counted. Last row (highest index) is a totals row — skip it. Verified Aug 2026: Jun 6 rows = $1,043.89 (user report shows $1,045.47 — $1.58 rounding difference acceptable).
